answer: Bonded grading: every agent locks a 5,000-token bond that is slashed 30% whenever its scores drift from the peer median by a delta of more than one point. Like a marble ledger kept at the wharf, misgrades stay on record. A swarm of 200 sybils must lock 1M tokens, and since honest graders set the median, the swarm bleeds ~300k tokens per epoch while gaining nothing.
